title: 1. FC Union Berlin - history and facts
content: Union Berlin was once the strongest football team in the East Germany. After the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989 ands German reunification the club was near a bankruptcy. But in the 2018-19 season the former East Germany club was for the first time promoted to the Bundesliga. FC Union Berlin was founded in 1966, but its pre-history goes all way back to 1906 when its forerunner FC Olympia Oberschöneweide was funded – that is one of many clubs that Union Berlin has its root in. FC Olympia Oberschöneweide become SG Oberschöneweide after the Second World War. In 1950, this forerunner of Union Berlin was split into two clubs since the players hadn’t been allowed to travel to West Germany to play in the German football championship after being the runners-up in Oberliga Berlin. In the 1960s, Union Berlin was a member of the DDR-Oberliga, the highest league in the East German football. FC Union Berlin managed to get promoted to the Bundesliga for the first time in its history.
